thread:
clare: Dropped two prototypes for the Usage page: 'quick-action tiles' vs 'ledger rows'. Figma: https://figma.com/file/usage-tiles-vs-ledger — need quick takes on invoice discoverability, token visibility, and keyboard/accessibility.

peter: Quick read: tiles are friendlier for small orgs, ledger scales better. Major question: where do we put invoice downloads? Inline on each tile/row, or a top-level bulk export?

izzy: My vote: both. Small inline quick-download (ellipsis menu -> Download latest invoice (CSV)) + a bulk "Download selected" header action. Keeps discoverability without clutter.

infra-bot: Backend note: immediate CSV generation is fine for <=50 workspaces. For >50, run async job and email a gzipped CSV when ready. Recommend chunking and rate-limit.

clare: Good call. For the tiles variant I'm proposing a tiny 24x48 raster microchart and a compact token pill (percent) that expands on click for exact counts. Hover-only details won't work on mobile.

peter: Implementation note: avoid rendering an SVG per card at scale. Suggest server-side pre-rendered PNGs or a single offscreen canvas instead of many DOM SVGs.

izzy: Accessibility: if tiles are focusable, we need grid semantics (role="grid", role="row", role="gridcell") and roving tabindex for arrow keys. Also ensure tiles expose aria-labels for the download action: "Download invoice for <workspace> as CSV".

a11y-bot: Color contrast warning: current accent for chip text fails AA at small sizes. Use updated swatch #5f7be6. Also tooltips must be reachable via keyboard and dismissible with Esc.

clare: I'll update colors. Also thinking of a sticky scope toolbar (Org / Workspace) so switching doesn't cause layout jumps. Pin it under the main nav.

peter: Sticky toolbar + pinned scope is good. Add a small radiogroup with proper aria roles for the scope switch so SRs announce state changes. Use aria-live polite when results finish loading.

izzy: For bulk downloads, UX: show FAB bottom-right when in select mode with label "Download N invoices (CSV)". If N>50, show a confirmation modal that explains async export. FAB should be disabled if zero selected with tooltip "Select workspaces to enable bulk download".

infra-bot: Confirmed: async export estimated at ~0.5s per workspace on current infra; recommend gzip for large outputs and an email link when job completes. Also include filename schema: redwood-invoices_<scope>_<start>_<end>.csv.gz.

clare: Copy nit: change per-item menu text to "Download latest invoice (CSV)" and per-item tooltip to "Latest invoice for this workspace 026-03-01 026-03-31". For bulk CTA: "Download invoices for selected workspaces (CSV)".

peter: Keyboard shortcut idea: press D to toggle select mode, Shift+D to start bulk download. Add a small hint next to the scope toggle for power users. Make sure shortcuts are documented and user-configurable.

izzy: Dev constraints: precompute 7/30/90 token aggregates server-side to avoid on-the-fly computation on page load. Expose lightweight fields in usage API so front-end doesn't compute totals.

a11y-bot: Focus guidance: when opening a popover for token counts, trap focus and restore to the trigger on close. When closing the async-export modal, announce job queued with aria-live and provide link to export history.

clare: Action items: 1) I'll update Figma with rasterized microcharts, sticky scope toolbar, FAB behavior, and copy changes; 2) @infra-bot please add async export config to the infra RFC; 3) @izzy can you draft the a11y checklist for the handoff. Planning a short review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
